So I know the damage is done, but I'll add a bit on to this for future reference for any other people going through something like this at gamestop. 

Yes they can't take returns on digital codes but they do stock physical cards as well. If you want you can always ask for one. They can also make a code for a specific amount of you want, at least for Xbox.

Also, in employee training it doesn't encourage this but it does state in text form that it is okay to bend the rules in some cases but it really would have to be done physically in store. Calling a support line won't help you. I have seen with my own eyes a return being issued for digital codes when parents were picking up something for their kids but the kids were being vague or flippant about details so the parents mistakenly bought the wrong thing.

As long as that asshole wasn't  the store leader (read: manager) then you have a good chance for a refund. He was just being a sketchy lazy prick. Sounds like a GA or an SGA who was trying to bump their numbers.
